module: Shared 'Bake' helper of the editor's spline tools. As long as a spline belongs to its tool, its generated objects (TSStatic, DecalRoad, river) are transient (canSave=false). Bake commits them to the level: sets objects and SimGroup folder to canSave=true and removes the spline from the tool without deleting anything. Everything is driven by a `spec` table provided by the tool (toolId, displayName, getBakeTarget, rebuildNow, burn, detach, finalizeFolder, removeFromTool, captureState, restoreState, findSpline, optionally iconColor/iconSize/bakeIcon/canBake/rowIconSize). The operation is a single undoable history transaction, without a dialog.
notes: LOCK mode: if spec.setLockedById exists, the button deletes nothing: it locks the spline (isEnabled=false), its objects are saved with the level and collide; it stays in the tool and can be unlocked (undoable).
Default bakeability rule: spline enabled, not linked (isLink), with at least 2 nodes; can be overridden by spec.canBake.
rowButton: after a click (returns true), the caller must call editor.endWindow() then return, because the tool's item list was modified during iteration.
renderButton calls im.NextColumn(); renderButtonInline does not handle any column.

renderButton.desc: Column variant: draws the Bake button as a column cell (the caller must increase its im.Columns by 1). If there is no bakeable spline selected, the cell is an empty Dummy.

renderButtonInline.desc: Inline variant: draws the Bake button (or a Dummy) without column handling; the caller does its own im.SameLine() beforehand.

rowButton.desc: Row variant: Bake button for the spline of a list row (small icon), or Dummy if it is not bakeable. A click bakes immediately and returns true.

returns.desc: true if a bake occurred (the caller must end its window). Always false in LOCK mode.

burnById.desc: Master-Spline propagation: bakes the spline with the given id (typically a linked child) without opening its own history transaction; the Master Spline wraps everything in one action.

returns.desc: { manifest, items, folderId } to allow undo, or nil if the id is not found.

unburn.desc: Resumes a bake: deletes the burned objects and the planted forest items, reloads the collision and sets the folder back to transient (cansave=false).

setLocked.desc: Locks/unlocks `spline` in one undoable history transaction. Used by the flame button and the tool's lock toggle.

isLocked.desc: true to lock, false to unlock.
